strategy: blight burn / -1/-1 counters as a damage trigger
identity: A two-colour B/R blight deck whose damage comes off triggers rather than the combat step. Lasting Tarfire converts any -1/-1 counter placed during a turn into 2 damage at each end step, and the list is built so that a counter gets placed at zero card cost on every one of your own turns — Warren Torchmaster at the beginning of combat on your turn, Scuzzback Scrounger at the beginning of your first main phase, and Gristle Glutton via an untimed tap ability. The opponent's end-step trigger is a bonus, not a guarantee: 6 of the 23 nonland cards can place a counter during the opponent's turn (Gristle Glutton x2 and Sting-Slinger x2, whose tap abilities carry no timing restriction and must be activated before their end step begins, and Requiting Hex x2 at instant speed). Every interaction spell in the deck pays its discount by placing that same counter, so removal and clock are the same card. The undercosted blight bodies (Chaos Spewer 5/4 for two) are the landing pads for those counters and a real ground clock underneath the burn.

restrictions.extra_build_constraint: at most 5 rare+mythic cards total across mainboard and sideboard

mainboard.name: Lasting Tarfire
mainboard.oracle_text: At the beginning of each end step, if you put a counter on a creature this turn, this enchantment deals 2 damage to each opponent.

mainboard.name: Sting-Slinger
mainboard.oracle_text: {1}{R}, {T}, Blight 1: This creature deals 2 damage to each opponent. (To blight 1, put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)

mainboard.name: Boggart Mischief
mainboard.oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, you may blight 1. If you do, create two 1/1 black and red Goblin creature tokens. (To blight 1, put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)
Whenever a Goblin creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

mainboard.name: Chaos Spewer
mainboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may pay {2}. If you don't, blight 2. (To blight 2, put two -1/-1 counters on a creature you control.)

mainboard.name: Shadow Urchin
mainboard.oracle_text:
Whenever this creature attacks, blight 1. (Put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)
Whenever a creature you control with one or more counters on it dies, exile that many cards from the top of your library. Until your next end step, you may play those cards.

mainboard.name: Soul Immolation
mainboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, blight X. X can't be greater than the greatest toughness among creatures you control. (Put X -1/-1 counters on a creature you control.)
Soul Immolation deals X damage to each opponent and each creature they control.

mainboard.name: Warren Torchmaster
mainboard.oracle_text: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may blight 1. When you do, target creature gains haste until end of turn. (To blight 1, put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)

mainboard.name: Gristle Glutton
mainboard.oracle_text: {T}, Blight 1: Discard a card. If you do, draw a card. (To blight 1, put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)

mainboard.name: Scuzzback Scrounger
mainboard.oracle_text: At the beginning of your first main phase, you may blight 1. If you do, create a Treasure token. (To blight 1, put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control. A Treasure token is an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")

mainboard.name: Burning Curiosity
mainboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may blight 1. (You may put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)
Exile the top two cards of your library. If this spell's additional cost was paid, exile the top three cards instead. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.

mainboard.name: Cinder Strike
mainboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may blight 1. (You may put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)
Cinder Strike deals 2 damage to target creature. It deals 4 damage to that creature instead if this spell's additional cost was paid.

mainboard.name: Requiting Hex
mainboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may blight 1. (You may put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)
Destroy target creature with mana value 2 or less. If this spell's additional cost was paid, you gain 2 life.

mainboard.name: Bogslither's Embrace
mainboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, blight 1 or pay {3}. (To blight 1, put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)
Exile target creature.

mainboard.name: Blood Crypt
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {B} or {R}.)
As this land enters, you may pay 2 life. If you don't, it enters tapped.

mainboard.name: Geothermal Bog
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {B} or {R}.)
This land enters tapped.

sideboard.name: Giantfall
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.
• Destroy target artifact.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs artifact decks (11 artifacts in cube, 4.2% density) — 'Destroy target artifact'; mode 1 stays live otherwise

sideboard.name: Dawnhand Dissident
sideboard.oracle_text:
{T}, Blight 1: Surveil 1.
{T}, Blight 2: Exile target card from a graveyard.
During your turn, you may cast creature spells from among cards you own exiled with this creature by removing three counters from among creatures you control in addition to paying their other costs.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs graveyard decks (39 cards, 15.0% density) — repeatable '{T}, Blight 2: Exile target card from a graveyard' at 1 mana, and the blight is itself a Lasting Tarfire enabler

sideboard.name: Boulder Dash
sideboard.oracle_text: Boulder Dash deals 2 damage to any target and 1 damage to any other target.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs wide token boards — kills two x/1 or x/2 bodies for 2 mana on 11 red sources, and can go to the face

sideboard.name: Darkness Descends
sideboard.oracle_text: Put two -1/-1 counters on each creature.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs the widest token boards only; symmetric, and it kills our own 4 Goblin tokens, so 1 copy not 2

sideboard.name: Blight Rot
sideboard.oracle_text: Put four -1/-1 counters on target creature.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs single large threats — instant-speed four -1/-1 counters, and the only removal that satisfies Lasting Tarfire off an OPPONENT's creature

sideboard.name: Sear
sideboard.oracle_text: Sear deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs evasive fliers and planeswalkers (evasion density 15.8%, 41 cards)

strategy_es: quemar con blight / contadores -1/-1 como disparo de daño
identity_es: Un mazo de blight bicolor B/R cuyo daño viene de disparos y no del paso de combate. Lasting Tarfire convierte cualquier contador -1/-1 colocado durante un turno en 2 de daño en cada paso final, y la lista está construida para que se coloque un contador sin coste de cartas en todos y cada uno de tus propios turnos: Warren Torchmaster al comienzo del combate en tu turno, Scuzzback Scrounger al comienzo de tu primera fase principal, y Gristle Glutton mediante una habilidad de giro sin restricción de tiempo. El disparo del paso final del rival es una propina, no una garantía: 6 de las 23 cartas no-tierra pueden colocar un contador durante el turno del rival (Gristle Glutton x2 y Sting-Slinger x2, cuyas habilidades de giro no llevan restricción de tiempo y deben activarse antes de que empiece su paso final, y Requiting Hex x2 a velocidad de instantáneo). Cada hechizo de interacción del mazo paga su descuento colocando ese mismo contador, así que eliminación y reloj son la misma carta. Los cuerpos infracosteados con blight (Chaos Spewer 5/4 por dos) son las pistas de aterrizaje de esos contadores y un reloj terrestre real por debajo del quemar.
